title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 1:18-25
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 1:18-25</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="18" /> Now, the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενεσις">birth-beginning  </char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous Messiah</char> was this way: 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          His mother, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Maria</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          having been <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">engaged</char> to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">before they had come together</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          she was found to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">have in the womb by the Holy Spirit</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="19" /> and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph her husband</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          being a righteous one, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          and not desiring to make her a public spectacle, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">he</char> wanted to send <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">her</char> away privately. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="20" /> And while he was thinking about these things, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">a messenger of the Lord</char> appeared to him in <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">a dream</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph</char>, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">of Dauid</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          do not be afraid <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">to take</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Maria</char> as your <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">wife</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          because what has been <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">inside her</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">is from the Holy Spirit</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="21" /> and she will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth</char> a <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">you will call his name</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous</char>,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          because he will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">save</char> his people from their moral-failings.” 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="22" /> And all of this happened 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet would be filled-full, saying, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <verse number="23" /> “Look, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">the virgin</char> will <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">have in the womb</char> and will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth</char> a <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">they will call his name</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">Emmanuel</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        which is translated ‘<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">With Us Is God</char>.’” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="24" /> And, after <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph</char> got up from <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">sleep</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        he did as <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the messenger of the Lord</char> commanded him, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">he took his</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">wife</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="25" /> and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">he did not know her</char> until she <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> a <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he called his name <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous</char>.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
